lines.prompt: Derive the Boolean equation for output n16 in terms of its primary inputs.

golden.reference: n16 is a registered output (Q of DFF g1027, netlist line 1618: dff g1027(.RN(n1), .SN(1'b1), .CK(n0), .D(n1747), .Q(n16))), so it has no combinational Boolean function of the primary inputs; treating register outputs as pseudo-inputs, the equation degenerates to the trivial identity n16 = n16.
golden.notes: Netlist-verified: n16 is driven directly by DFF g1027's Q pin, so no pure-PI combinational closed form exists. Verified full-score teams split into two acceptable presentations: Team3 and Team4 give the trivial identity 'n16'; Team7 explains it is a registered output with no pure-PI closed form and supplies the next-state expression over register outputs. Team2 (non-authoritative log) also gives the identity 'n16', corroborating but not anchoring. Judge: accept either the identity n16 or a registered-output explanation (optionally with a next-state equation); reject any answer asserting a nontrivial combinational PI equation for n16 itself.
